generic_K3_realization.reason: Kondo Section 4.5 excludes the S3 factor from the symplectic action on the general surface.  Exact discriminant action is nontrivial of order three, so it cannot glue to the identity transcendental action of a symplectic order-three automorphism at a general period.  A special period with a matching non-scalar transcendental Hodge isometry is not assessed.
